intro: Home is your daily desk. Buddy greets you, then his toolbox logs the day. Today’s Progress fills after you save. Beginner, Standard, and Power User are the same Home with more or less on screen — switch with PX in the bottom bar.
buddyTip: Camera is the food log. Water, Weight, and Cart sit beside it as quiet chips. Cart is last. The Camera chevron picks Camera, Photo, Receipt / File, Text input, or Voice (A–Z).
mission: Open Home, tap Camera (or Water / Weight), confirm Buddy’s estimate, and watch Today’s Progress (or your Beginner task list) update after save.
why: Wrong-door logging is the most common frustration. People open Foodiary to invent a blank row, leave kcal empty, then wonder why Progress stays at zero. Home is the smart door into the ledger.
The orange Camera button is Buddy’s main food log. Water, Weight, and Cart sit beside it. Text input is a Camera method, not a second Food button.
Experience Mode (PX) is presentation only. Beginner hides the dashboard. Standard shows the budget. Power adds TEF and leucine. Your logs do not change.

what.lead: What you should recognise on Home (mobile).
points: Buddy host — greeting plus Camera, Water, Weight, Cart
Camera — tap to scan a pack or plate; chevron chooses Camera, Photo, Receipt / File, Text input, Voice
Today’s Progress (Standard / Power) or Today’s Health + task list (Beginner)
PX pill in the bottom bar — Beg / Std / Pwr
Bottom tabs — Beginner is Home · Foodiary · Progress · Menu; Standard and Power add Meal Plan, Activity, Spaces

misconceptions.myth: Home is just a dashboard; real logging happens in Foodiary.
misconceptions.truth: Prefer Home for new meals. Foodiary is for review and corrections.

misconceptions.myth: Tapping Camera only chooses a method.
misconceptions.truth: Camera logs immediately with the selected method. The chevron only chooses the method.

steps: Tap Camera to scan, or pick Text input from the Camera chevron to type
Confirm Buddy’s estimate; adjust grams if you know better
Use Water, Weight, or Cart when that is the job
Glance at Today’s Progress or the task list — then return to life
how.buddyHelps: Buddy reduces friction and teaches while capturing. Progress on Home is immediate feedback that the loop worked.

sections.title: Experience Mode (PX)
paras: Beginner: greeting, today’s health, daily task list. Tap a meal row to log. No camera bar, no Meal Plan / Activity / Spaces tabs.
Standard: log bar + energy budget (Food · Exercise · Remaining) + health cards.
Power User: same as Standard, plus TEF on the budget and leucine on protein.
PX is beta presentation. No data loss when you switch.

sections.title: Today’s Progress
paras: Treat it as a compass, not a courtroom. If it doesn’t move, check that the saved row has energy values and that you’re viewing today.

mistakes.quote: I added a Foodiary row with no kcal and thought Home was broken.
mistakes.why: Blank-kcal rows don’t teach Progress. Log via Buddy on Home or fill nutrition.

mistakes.quote: I looked for a Food button next to Camera.
mistakes.why: Food logging is Camera. Type a meal with Text input in the Camera menu. Weight is the fourth chip.

mistakes.quote: I only open Progress tab, never Home.
mistakes.why: Progress needs inputs. Capture on Home first.

encouragement: Home is where honesty becomes easy. Tap Camera or Weight, confirm, glance, go.
